summary: Fremont County lookout: 1942 tower with live-in cab, reported destroyed or removed in 1966; FFLA lists it as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: FFLA list shows the tower as gone; no source describes what remains on the site today

events.note: Tower with live-in cab. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives elevation 6372 ft.
firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed; Forest Lookouts says removed.

evidence.supports: Elk Butte in Fremont County is marked tower gone on the FFLA list
about 24 miles northeast of Saint Anthony
Clearwater County Elk Butte is a different, standing tower
evidence.quote: Elk Butte Clearwater 46.84084 -116.11757 Tower Standing NHLR US 216, ID 16

evidence.supports: Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history for the tower
evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

evidence.supports: 1942 tower with live-in cab erected (Forest Lookouts)
evidence.quote: 1942: A tower with live-in cab was erected. (Kresek)

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts says the 1966 event was removal

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say the tower was destroyed in 1966; Forest Lookouts says removed. Event recorded as destroyed from two sources; story reports the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Several Elk Butte lookouts exist. The Clearwater County Elk Butte (NHLR US 216, ID 16) is standing and is a different site; the story says so to avoid mix-ups. The 1966 event conflicts (destroyed vs removed). Elevation 6372 ft is in the note, not facts. No photos added. No site-today source found in two searches.
